subject: Security & Compliance deep-dive: encryption, audit logs, SSO — reschedule and plan
messages:
From: Ravi Shah <ravi@helixhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Deep-dive request — encryption, audit logs, SSO (SOC 2)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intake call last week. Helix's SOC 2 team is ready to schedule a technical deep-dive to review the areas we flagged: encryption at rest & in transit, audit log retention and access patterns, and SSO/SAML setup (IdP, Just-in-Time provisioning). We'd like a session where your infra/infra-security folks can walk through architecture diagrams and the evidence we should expect to surface.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:30 (PT)
- Wed Jul 7, 09:00–10:30 (PT)

We typically allocate 90 minutes so we can go into the evidence mapping and ask follow-ups. Attached is our preliminary questionnaire (helix_prelim_questionnaire.pdf) to help guide the session.

Attendees from our side: Ravi Shah (Security Lead), Marta Lopez (Engineering Manager), and SOC2 reviewers (cc).

Can you confirm availability or propose alternatives this week? Also let us know who from Redwood will be joining and whether you can split the session if needed.

Best,
Ravi
Ravi Shah
Security Lead, Helix Health
ravi@helixhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: helix_prelim_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi@helixhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — encryption, audit logs, SSO (SOC 2)

Hi Ravi — thanks, and appreciate the questionnaire.

Quick notes on availability: the Windows you proposed overlap with our quarterly planning offsite — several of our infra folks will be out Tue afternoon and Wed morning PT. I can join either slot, but to make this productive I want Neha (security engineering) and Irene (platform infra) present.

Two options from our side:
1) Keep a single 90-minute session but move earlier on Wed (07-Jul, 08:00–09:30 PT) — that would get both Neha and Irene in.
2) Split into two focused 45–50 minute sessions to reduce scheduling friction:
   - Session A: Encryption & audit logs (45m)
   - Session B: SSO, IdP, provisioning, session management (45m)

I'll attach a quick SSO diagram and a suggested split agenda. If you prefer the split sessions we can propose concrete times and calendar invites.

Proposed attendee list from Redwood: Dylan Brooks (Solutions), Neha Kapoor (Security Eng), Irene Choi (Platform Infra).

Link to private docs for the call (read-only): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFgHIJ_kEYz

Thanks — I’ll hold 07-Jul 08:00–09:30 PT tentatively while we decide.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_sso_diagram.png (PNG, 148 KB)

From: Ravi Shah <ravi@helixhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>, Helix Health SOC2 Team <soc2@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — encryption, audit logs, SSO (SOC 2)

Dylan — thanks for the fast reply and the diagram.

Unfortunately the earlier Wed slot conflicts with a vendor review we can't move. Splitting into two shorter sessions sounds better for our reviewers. If we split, can we do: 
- Wed Jul 7, 09:00–09:45 PT — Encryption & Audit logs
- Wed Jul 7, 10:15–11:00 PT — SSO & Access controls

Both sessions can be 45 minutes each; we have slightly different reviewers for each topic so separate invites are fine. Please confirm timezone (PT) and if those times work for Neha and Irene.

Also: we'll share a short list of additional evidence requests by EOD today so you can prepare artifacts.

--Ravi
Ravi Shah
Security Lead, Helix Health

Attachment: (none)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi@helixhealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — encryption, audit logs, SSO (SOC 2)

Thanks team — splitting is the right move. A couple quick operational asks so both sessions are efficient: 

Proposed short plan:
- Session 1 (45m): Encryption & Audit logs
  - 10 min: architecture overview (KMS, key rotation, envelope encryption)
  - 20 min: audit log architecture (collection points, retention, immutable storage)
  - 10 min: sample artifacts and Q&A

- Session 2 (45m): SSO & Access controls
  - 15 min: SAML flow and provisioning (IdP metadata, assertion mapping)
  - 15 min: role mapping, session timeout, SCIM support
  - 15 min: evidence mapping and next steps

Action items for Redwood (pre-call):
- Upload a redacted sample audit log and the KMS key rotation SOP to the Drive link by EOD Tue.
- Prepare a short diagram of the logging pipeline (collector -> event store -> retention policy).
- Share the proposed attendee list for each session (who will be on camera).

If we split, I'll create a combined calendar .ics with both invites to reduce friction. I'll also include the proposed mutual action plan in the invites.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_split_sessions.ics (ICS, 2 KB)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — encryption, audit logs, SSO (SOC 2)

Hi Ravi / Marta — thanks, confirmed.

We will plan for two focused sessions on Wed Jul 7 (times PT):
- 09:00–09:45 — Encryption & Audit logs (Dylan, Neha)
- 10:15–11:00 — SSO & Access controls (Irene, Dylan)

I've attached the calendar with both invites and a drive folder with the documents Neha requested. Please RSVP and share any additional attendees for each session. If you post the short evidence list you mentioned we’ll mark owners internally and upload redacted samples ahead of the call.

For visibility, quoting Ravi's earlier note:
> Unfortunately the earlier Wed slot conflicts with a vendor review we can't move. Splitting into two shorter sessions sounds better for our reviewers.

Links and attachments:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFgHIJ_kEYz
- Calendar (attached): proposed_split_sessions.ics

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Dylan
